decisions.reason: It builds closely on established navigation and observation camera knowledge, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve it through internal R&D and research cooperation.
Although miniaturized LiDAR is somewhat newer, it draws on the firm's optical sensor and optoelectronic know-how, and ongoing R&D cooperation supports learning and improvement.
Radiation-hard space cameras extend the firm's proven space camera and electronics expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate early results and refine the product line.

Asteroid navigation and imaging builds on existing camera and navigation capabilities, but its more specialized application makes learning and improvement somewhat less certain, though still within absorptive capacity.
